name: Caprese Gnocchi Bake
steps: Prepare the tomatoes. Cut the stem out of any big vine tomatoes and cut into chunks. Mix together with the cherry tomatoes.

Get your oil in an oven safe frying pan over a medium heat. If you don't have one, a regular frying pan will be fine! Just transfer the food to a baking dish a few steps down. Slice your garlic and add into the pan along with the chilli flakes, cook for a couple of minutes.
Add in the tomatoes, cook until they begin to break up and bubble down into a fresh tomato sauce. Add in the basil.
Add the gnocchi to a bowl and cover with boiling water. Leave for 5 minutes, then drain, reserving some of the gnocchi water. Heat the grill to high.

Drain the gnocchi and add into the tomato sauce with a slosh of the gnocchi water. Stir together and bubble down in the pan for a couple of minutes until you have a nice thick gnocchi sauce. Season with salt and pepper and tear in the basil.
Pour the gnocchi into a baking dish if you aren't already using an oven safe pan. Tear up the mozzarella and scatter over the top.
Place under the grill for 7-8 minutes until the cheese is golden and bubbling. Remove, serve up and scatter with more basil if you like.
